snippet.title: Night at the Meowseum -  Release Trailer (App Store)
snippet.description:
Now available on the App Store!
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/night-at-the-meowseum/id6449209807

Help the Guard Misu to patrol the Meowseum from mischievous thieves in this pawesome puzzle adventure ! 

FEATURES
- An all-cat cast of memorable characters
- Turn based Puzzle battles
- A 2.5D world with paper-style characters and a unique children's book visual
- Collect the Meowseum’s artifacts
- Enjoy vividly colored, hand-drawn 2D animation cat-scene
- dive into a parody world inspired by Italian culture
- Encounter guests from other indie games while patrolling the Meowseum!

Play for free with ads or buy the full version and enjoy the game without any ads!
Experience new story episodes, new artifacts, and more in following game updates!

📱Android version coming later this month!
💖Don't forget to subscribe & like to support our game!

 Developed by Alunite, inc
